description: You are the Financial Controller at Meridian Capital Partners, a registered investment advisory firm. The SEC has launched a routine examination (Exam #2024-NY-0847) and FINRA has opened a separate net capital review (Case FR-2024-NY-0312). Your inbox has accumulated a backlog of examination correspondence that the compliance team needs organized before regulators arrive on-site next week. Create a 'Regulatory' folder in Local Folders with two subfolders: 'SEC_Examination' for all SEC correspondence and 'FINRA_Review' for all FINRA correspondence. Move each email to the correct subfolder. Add the lead SEC examiner Jennifer Kowalski (jkowalski@sec.gov) to your address book. Then compose a draft email reply to Jennifer Kowalski's initial examination notice (the first email you received from her) to acknowledge the examination and confirm you will have document categories ready: your compliance manual, client list, and code of ethics. Save it as a draft — do not send. Login: local account, no password needed.
